scope_change: User requested (mid-run) to stop translating 3-4 hanzi words and continue with 2-hanzi compounds only. Waves 1-2 (mixed length, already in flight at the time) were kept since already processed. From wave 3 onward (renamed batches_2char), batches are built from a 2-hanzi-only filtered list. Separately, user requested adding 4-5 char idioms (thành ngữ) as an additional stream (see idiom_stage below), processed in parallel.
